next.reason: 1985 GR6: format-2 ACCEPT transfers to identifier-2 'according to the rules for the MOVE statement'; DATE, DAY, DAY-OF-WEEK and TIME 'are conceptual data items'. §2023:14.9.1.4 GR6 repeats both ('are conceptual data items and, therefore, are not described in the COBOL source unit'); its 'reference the current date and time provided by the system' restates 1985 GR7-GR10. §2023:14.9.1.3 SR3 'Identifier-2 shall not reference a data item of class alphabetic, ... index' states the receivers the 1985 MOVE rules already refused for these numeric sources; the other classes it names do not exist in 1985. Same programs accepted and refused, same effect. YYYYMMDD/YYYYDDD are new phrases of the format record, not of this rule.
